needs_human.note: Each PDF full-screen page mounts its own HighlightControls, so there are several selectionchange and scroll listeners.; The remove control is dismissed on any window scroll (capture phase).; Mark wrappers are unwrapped and `normalize()` is called on the parent on every redraw, which could merge adjacent text nodes that other code (in-file find) holds references to.
HighlightControls.tsx, types/raw.d.ts, the TextLines key change and the DEFERRED_ARRANGEMENTS bootstrap are not in the touch points.
